actors.name: Péter Magyar
actors.blurb: Magyar has rapidly become a defining figure in Hungary's political landscape following his election as Prime Minister. His government's efforts to dismantle the legacy of Viktor Orbán, including proposed constitutional amendments to remove President Tamás Sulyok and introduce term limits for MPs, have generated significant controversy. The ongoing 'gold convoy' scandal, involving allegations of corruption and money laundering, has further intensified scrutiny of his leadership.
